about: Fixed prompt suite for the Goal Translator (spec section 9). expect = collapsed window classes in order: L left-turning, R right-turning, S straight and moving, X standing, U unspecified. forbid = classes that must not appear. The first case is the prompt that motivated the module: the wave is not expressible and must not become a made-up turn. tier easy = plain phrasings a keyword-level parser should get; tier hard = typos, direction lists with no separators, abbreviations, reordering: the learned model should beat stage C here.
